JustDrones

Tap the drone puck to start or stop the drones.

Select a pitch and adjust the first drone's volume.

Select an optional second drone interval and adjust its volume independently.

The second drone uses the original just-intonation interval samples.

Use Fine Tuning to adjust both drones together, and Reset to return to the original tuning.

Your settings are saved in this browser when available.

Playback stops when you leave or hide the page; tap the drone puck to restart it.
